en-GB.name: ${SKILL_NAME}
en-GB.summary: Your Recipator shopping list, by voice.
en-GB.description: Add items to your Recipator shopping list, tick them off and hear what is still on it. A private skill for the family.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask ${INVOCATION_NAME} to add milk to my list
Alexa, ask ${INVOCATION_NAME} to tick off eggs
Alexa, ask ${INVOCATION_NAME} what's on my list

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Link a Recipator account, then add, tick off and read back shopping-list items.
